newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico busts members of drug gang, federal policeman.
newsitem.headline: Mexico busts members of drug gang, federal policeman.

text.p: Mexican police on Wednesday arrested six alleged members of a well-known Mexican drug cartel, including one federal police agent.

The Attorney General's Office said in a statement the men admitted to working for Hector "The Blonde" Palma Salazar, a jailed drug lord who is believed to be a major figure in the Sinaloa cocaine cartel.
The men were arrested in a Mexico City restaurant. In their cars, police found limited quantities of cocaine and marijuana and several high-calibre weapons, including three AK-47 automatic rifles.
